# alethech

> Verifiable agent continuity protocol — Ed25519-signed memory, hash-linked DAG, key rotation with reachability guarantee.

## What is this?

alethech is a Python package that provides cryptographically verifiable memory continuity for AI agents. It lets an agent sign its memory commits with Ed25519, link them in a Merkle DAG, rotate keys without losing identity, and prove to a third party that its memory was not tampered with.

## Key facts

- **Language**: Python 3.10+
- **License**: MIT
- **Version**: 0.8.5
- **Dependencies**: cryptography + click (only 2)
- **Tests**: 230 passing, 8 mutation-guard paths
- **PyPI**: https://pypi.org/project/alethech/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/eddyflores100-lang/alethech
- **Landing page**: https://alethech.alicelabs.site/

## What it does

1. Ed25519 signatures on every memory commit
2. SHA-256 content addressing (JCS RFC 8785 canonicalization)
3. Key rotation preserving identity (root authority → operational keys)
4. Reachability guarantee: revoked key commits checked against ancestry(cutoff_head)
5. External checkpoints prove continuity (monotonic sequence, NOT system clock)
6. Atomic import (verify-then-write, target untouched on failure)

## What it does NOT do

- Prove content is true (only that it was signed)
- Encrypt content at rest
- Detect rollback without external checkpoint
- Delegate permissions between agents
- Call any LLM (zero-LLM by design)

## CLI commands

```
alethech init                    # generate identity + genesis commit
alethech commit --content <file> # create signed MemoryCommit
alethech evidence --tool <name>  # create signed EvidenceCommit
alethech verify                  # verify the whole store, offline
alethech export --output <dir>   # portable package
alethech import --input <dir>    # import external memory
alethech key rotate              # rotate operational key
alethech key revoke --key-id X   # revoke a key
alethech migrate --to v0.2       # migrate identity layer
```

## Install

```bash
pip install alethech
```

## Interactive terminal

The landing page has a live terminal that runs REAL Ed25519 + SHA-256 + JCS in your browser via Web Crypto API. No backend, no simulation.

Visit: https://alethech.alicelabs.site/

## Cryptographic primitives

- Ed25519 (RFC 8032) — signatures
- SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) — hashing
- JCS (RFC 8785) — JSON canonicalization
- Base32 (RFC 4648) — agent_id encoding

## Semantic guarantees

```
commit ∈ ancestry(cutoff_head)  →  VALID_HISTORICAL
commit ∉ ancestry(cutoff_head)  →  NOT_IN_PROVEN_PRE_ROTATION_HISTORY
```

The verifier does NOT claim to prove WHEN a commit was created — only membership in the causal frontier covered by cutoff_head.

## Audit history

- tonydzi (Palo Alto AI Research Lab) — found reachability guarantee gap, fixed in 0.5.2
- Kaushalt2004 (CogniCore) — implemented firing test, merged with 14/14 passing
- Security audit score: 80/100, OWASP Top 10 all pass
- Threat model: https://github.com/eddyflores100-lang/alethech/blob/main/SECURITY.md
